title: Turn text into SQL decision columns with Jev
description: Turn ticket text into queryable SQLite columns with JevSQL: preserve probabilities, review uncertainty, refresh changed records and evaluate before acting.

connections.step: Materialize bounded semantic judgments as SQLite decision columns
connections.why: Fluixo explicitly names JevSQL and its SQL functions. The catalog and pinned implementation identify EugeneBoondock/jevsql, whose engine resolves typed judgments and saves queryable decision tables with refresh history. It implements this table step, not the wine feature-discovery loop or authorization.
connections.limitations: MIT Node library/CLI 0.1.0; Node >=22.16. Live row text goes to TypeSafe with an account/key and billed inference. Cost guards are estimates; mixed SQL collection clauses can widen disclosed rows, and refreshes can hold write-blocking transactions. Use authorized input and strictCollect. No live model or production dataset was tested; saved results can become stale after failure.

faqs.question: What does text to columns with Jev mean?
faqs.answer: It means asking bounded questions about each text record and storing the returned probabilities, categories or scores as reusable fields. SQL or a supervised model can consume those fields while code keeps exact calculations and authorization separate.

faqs.question: Is JevSQL a text-to-SQL model?
faqs.answer: No. You supply SQL and the questions. JevSQL resolves semantic functions and can save their results as ordinary SQLite tables; it does not generate an arbitrary database query from a user's request.

faqs.question: Does a Noul probability include confidence?
faqs.answer: Noul returns a yes-probability with no separate confidence field. Choice and Score include distributions and confidence. Neither a high probability nor high confidence guarantees that the allowed answer is correct.

faqs.question: Can I train CatBoost on Jev answers?
faqs.answer: Yes, numeric encodings can be features for a supervised model. TypeSafe's wine cookbook demonstrates means and spreads for Scores and probabilities for Nouls. Keep test labels outside feature discovery and evaluate against simpler baselines on your own data.

faqs.question: What happens when a JevSQL refresh fails?
faqs.answer: The saved table and history remain at their previous successful revision. Record the failure and expose stale or pending status; do not interpret old data as a fresh verdict or a missing answer as permission to act.
